description: Step 3 of Open Commerce Pathways: the default planning prompt for the x402 pathway you chose (one route resells it, two to five bundle them), shown in full before anything runs, with the compute terms. Edit it if you like, authorize one run with pathways_authorize, then call pathways_run. Free within the per-IP allowance, then $0.002. Live data only.
